feeds.title: Diary Of An Autodidact
feeds.description: I am an Exvangelical, having spent time both in Bill Gothard's cult, and in a religious tradition that has turned toxic. This blog focuses on what I am reading as I continue the process of learning and exploration. I also talk about hiking, music, me, and issues that I care about, particularly toxic religion, patriarchy, and ethical thinking. I'm a middle-aged solo practice lawyer. I play violin with the Bakersfield Symphony Orchestra. I also write for and serve on the editorial committee of the Res Ipsa Loquitur, the official publication of the Kern County Bar Association.

feeds.title: Brianna da Silva Blog
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm a fantasy/sci-fi novelist and filmmaker, sharing my experiences as a lesbian exvangelical, and my thoughts on writing, representation, and feminism.

feeds.title: Marie LePage Blog » Exvangelical
feeds.description: Here I publish articles related to topics I'm passionate about like secular spirituality, neurodivergence, ethical non-monogamy, and religious trauma. Marie LePage is a former Christian, now spiritual atheist.

feeds.title: Rebekah Drumsta Blog » Exvangelical
feeds.description: Follow my journey as an exvangelical after experiencing cults. I am a survivor of spiritual abuse and religious trauma which resulted in a Spiritual Identity Disruption.

feeds.title: She Seeks Nonfiction Blog » Exvangelical
feeds.description: Follow my exvangelical journey in this section along with my opinions and atheist thoughts' I'm Rebekah, a lifelong student, curious atheist, creative introvert, and intersectional feminist. I love to read and write about social justice, atheism, religion, science history, human evolution, and more.

feeds.title: The Exvangelical Parent
feeds.description: We are a community of misfits, questioners, and wanderers, sharing our stories and navigating ethics, morality, and spirituality in parenting. We come from a wide variety of backgrounds and religious traditions, but we are all on a journey of deconstructing/reconstructing and decolonize our faith, (or lack thereof.) We aspire to raise good humans without religious baggage who will make the world a better, more just, and more loving place.

feeds.title: Lenny Baker Blog
feeds.description: Lenny has escaped a cult, acquired a disability, adopted a cat, is trilingual and values kindness and authenticity above all else. Follow her journey as an evangelical, her thoughts and opinions and more.

feeds.title: Deconstruct With Me Blog
feeds.description: My name is Ida, and I am an exvangelical raised in both a Baptist and Catholic setting. This blog will detail my spiritual journey as I deconstruct old beliefs and attempt to make sense of them. Coming to terms with toxic Christianity is one of the reasons why I wanted to start this blog, as well as find other like minded people who have also been through the same or similar things.

feeds.title: Surviving the Spirit
feeds.description: My name is Danél Griffin, and I am a former Southern Baptist preacher - the son of a Southern Baptist preacher, who was the son of a Southern Baptist preacher. Up until 2006, I believed that the pulpit was the path to which God had called me, and I planned to serve God and follow that calling for the rest of my life. How I got to that point, and the life I've led since, will be chronicled in this blog. I hope that telling my story will inspire others and let them know that they do not suffer religious trauma on their own.

feeds.title: Beka Tucker » Exvangelical
feeds.description: Romp, expedition, adventure, odyssey, quest. Along the way, maybe I'll find better words to describe my life. My days are filled with the work of raising children, serving a retired canine racing queen, trying to run when my body allows it, hugging my husband, choosing between board games, books, and sleep, and never being truly bored.
